programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Hitler Strikes East
programme.desc: The German invasion of Russia from Operation Barbarossa on 22 June 1941 to Kursk on 5 July 1943.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Plas Teg
programme.desc: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Block
programme.desc: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Deborah Gibson, Joey Pantoliano, Kimberly Locke, Willie Garson
programme.desc: Deborah Gibson receives a message from the ghost of her idol; a murdered matriarch terrorizes Joey Pantoliano and his girlfriend.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Vince Neil, Laura Prepon, Connie Stevens, Haylie Duff
programme.desc: A small room in Laura Prepon's new home leaves her feeling very uneasy; a young Vince Neil hears mysterious noises coming from his bedroom closet.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Masonic Mysteries
programme.desc: Nick visits the Octagon Hall, a property built by a secret society known as the Freemasons.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: The Gallows
programme.desc: Nick visits The Gallows, a 150-year-old prison, feared and known for its harsh conditions and outcomes.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Charles Schaughnessy
programme.desc: Charles Shaughnessy (The Nanny / Days of Our Lives) stands up to his boyhood fears and returns to a legendary 16th century English castle where he had a supernatural experience.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: The Grey Figure
programme.desc: Nick visits a home constructed in 1894, hoping to shed light on the home's missing history.

programme.title: Mitt super-ex
programme.desc: Matt (Luke Wilson) tror sigha funnit den rätta när han träffar Jenny (Uma Thurman) som är både sexig och smart... Men när Mattbestämmer sig för att göra slut, blir det något han snart kommer att ångra.

programme.title: The Nanny: Where's Fran?
programme.desc: Maxwell's insults cause Fran to quit.

programme.title: The Nanny: Love Is A Many Blundered Thing
programme.desc: Convinced he's her secret admirer, Fran prepares an elaborate Valentine's Day surprise for Maxwell.

programme.title: The Nanny: Your Feets Too Big
programme.desc: An upcoming modeling reunion has Fran worried about aging.

programme.title: The Nanny: Where's The Pearls?
programme.desc: Fran loses both her memory and Elizabeth Taylor's priceless pearl necklace in an accident.

programme.title: The Nanny: Green Card
programme.desc: Maxwell is upset when Fran falls for Brighton's handsome French tutor.

programme.title: The Nanny: Ship Of Fran's
programme.desc: Maxwell arranges for everyone to join Fran on a Caribbean cruise.

programme.title: The Nanny: A Pup In Paris
programme.desc: A mix up ends with Fran joining Maxwell on a romantic trip to Paris.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Tart With Heart
programme.desc: Upon returning from Paris, Maxwell takes back his loving words to Fran.

programme.title: The Nanny: Me And Mrs. Joan
programme.desc: Fran arranges a reunion between Maxwell and his estranged father, James.

programme.title: The Nanny: Tattoo
programme.desc: Maxwell is aroused after learning that Fran has a secret tattoo.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Puerto Rico, a band of extremists waged a guerrilla war against the United States. Their goal, to make the island an independent nation, or die trying.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Women are most often assaulted by someone they know. Near Las Vegas in December of 2000 a young woman became the latest victim of a violent sex offender. Before authorities could locate him, he would add murder to his list of crimes.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 70s and early 80s, a legitimate Puerto Rican independence movement took hold in the United States. But a splinter terrorist group known as the FALN was suspected of executing hundreds of bombings in major US cities.

programme.title: Familjen Bélier

programme.title: Hemma i Hampstead

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2703

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2606

programme.desc: Reno Ward has a disastrous encounter with a speeding pick-up truck; Lisa Kelly attempts to rescue Reno but is forced to leave him to fend for himself; Art Burke attempts to deliver a Zamboni to save an isolated community's hockey season.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: A big bump takes out Art Burke's radiator; Todd Dewey's rig lands in a snowbank; Steph Custance regrets her foray onto a wet ice crossing; Alex Debogorski uses a sled to drag a construction shack across a frozen lake.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Lisa Kelly and Steph Custance team up for a challenging passage on the icy terrain; Art Burke brings a split load into the north country, hoping this will be his last load of the year; Todd Dewey hauls a double oversized camp shack.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Drivers head out one last time during the spring thaw; Steph Custance slides into trees; Todd Dewey struggles with a load on a twisty trail; Art Burke retrieves a heavy bulldozer; Reno Ward's truck dies on the ice; Lisa Kelly gets an emergency call.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: The Upside of Anger
programme.desc: Terry Wolfmeyer lever ett till synes normalt liv i förorten tillsammans med sin man och deras fyra döttrar. Hennes anspråkslösa tillvaro vänds dock upp och ner när hennes make plötsligt lämnar henne.

programme.title: Sångklubben
programme.desc: Kvinnorna på en militärbas i England försöker styra sinnet från sina bekymmer och tanken på en kör tar form. Men ingen av dem hade förväntat sig att uppträda i Royal Albert Hall...

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: När en gruva kollapsar i Kanada fångas en grupp gruvarbetare. Nu måste Jim hitta långtradarförare som kan transportera räddningsutrustning via farliga isvägar över frusna vatten innan det är för sent.

programme.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
programme.desc: Ivy balanserar julens åtaganden, sin dotter och motstridiga känslor för sin ex-make, allt medan en mystisk skojare orsakar förödelse i Candy Cane Lane.

programme.title: A Dash of Christmas
programme.desc: För att kunna söka sitt drömjobb på ett nystartat livsmedelsföretag måste en chef lära sig att baka. När hon rekryterar en stilig bagare för att hjälpa henne hamnar hon oavsiktligt i en julbakstävling.

programme.title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
programme.desc: Två rivaliserande fastighetsmäklare tvingas samarbeta för att sälja ett speciellt hus, ägt av en känd botaniker och mistelodlare, före jul.

programme.desc: A bikini photo shoot, a dress inspired by the movie The Princess Diaries II, and thirty dancers make up Janelle's Quinceanera. Let's hope her diva mother doesn't ruin it!

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Carlysia
programme.desc: With the famous R&B singer Gerald Levert as her father, Carlysia gets what she wants. This includes a personal assistant and famous friends.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Cher
programme.desc: Cher lives in a castle in the small town of Palm Harbor, Florida. Her best friend and mother is a V.I.P. of Saks Fifth Avenue. Cher's Sweet 16 theme is a Mardi Gras masquerade ball because it'll give her party a festive feel.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Stephanie
programme.desc: Stephanie is the ultimate perfectionist and everything in her life has to be exactly how she wants it, including her Quinceañera.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Amberly
programme.desc: Amberly, who hails from Virginia Beach, Virginia, has been referred to as the blonde Barbie. The theme for her My Super Sweet 16 party will be "Pink Ice."

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Erin
programme.desc: Erin is the daughter of the late rap pioneer Easy E and she's throwing the Sweet 16 she knows her famous father would have wanted her to have.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Katie
programme.desc: For her entire life, Katie has been pampered like the spoiled southern belle she is. She's never has to lift a finger. Katie is determined to bring Christmas to Memphis with her Sweet 16.

programme.desc: Teyana is a New Yorke singer, rapper and dancer from Harlem. This Harlem girl wants her 16th birthday bash to reflect her personality, so she's having an '80s old school skateboard sixteen-themed bash.

programme.desc: This Latino/Jewish prepster is an only child who's used to getting everything she wants. And what she wants right now is a party worthy of My Super Sweet 16. Her theme is a Winter Wonderland, because she loves the snow.

programme.desc: Destinee is the daughter of former NFL star Ray Buchanan. Because everyone knows who her dad is, she is convinced that if her Sweet 15 isn't the biggest and best, then her reputation will be totally ruined.

programme.desc: Audrey is the quintessential Miami girl, she loves the sun, the beach and, most of all, herself! And soon, this self-proclaimed princess will have the most extravagant and exciting My Super Sweet 16 bash that Miami has ever seen.

programme.title: Bride and Prejudice
programme.desc: En far söker lämpliga makar till sina fyra döttrar i denna färgstarka Bollywood-version av Jane Austens klassiker "Pride and Prejudice."

programme.title: Certified Copy

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of Truth
programme.desc: Nancy Newman and her two daughters are found brutally murdered. The crime scene has no shortage of evidence, but investigators cannot find a conclusive link to their prime suspect. To solve the puzzle, an FBI analyst designs a unique experiment.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Evidence
programme.desc: When police find the body of 11-year-old Krista Harrison, there are few clues to the killer's identity. But authorities are intrigued by unusual orange fibers embedded in clothing found near the victim.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kill'igraphy
programme.desc: This examination of the role autopsies play in murder investigations focuses on the suspicious death of Virginia Ridley. Police charge her mentally unstable husband with murder, but a medical examiner discovers that she died of natural causes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nursery Crimes
programme.desc: An investigation of a pediatrician, prompted by the mysterious death of one of her patients, leads to a Texas hospital where the pediatric mortality rate is higher than at any hospital in the country.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lasting Impression
programme.desc: When the decomposed body of a teenage girl is discovered, police have no clues to her identity. To solve the case, investigators turn to bug larvae found on the body and a tiny wad of chewing gum found near the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Foundation of Lies
programme.desc: Police suspect Dr. John "Jack" Boyle in the disappearance of his wife, Noreen, when he signs mortgage papers for a new house with a woman pretending to be his spouse. The police later find Noreen's body in the basement of Dr. Boyle's new house.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Vows
programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa, former head of the Romanian Orthodox Church in America, as having directed a bloody attack against Jews during World War II. He was deported in 1984 and died three years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular gym teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim just before his death tells the true story of his strange marriage and his wife's insatiable greed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Second Shot at Love
programme.desc: When heart surgeon Darryl Sutorius is found dead in the basement of his upscale Cincinnati home, police assume he committed suicide. Further investigation reveals that his new wife Della has a history of violence and an insatiable desire for money.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: We Can't Live Like This

programme.desc: Deshawn claims that his ex Lynette abandoned their 5-year-old son. But she claims that he is keeping her from their child. However, Deshawn recently found out that he isn't listed on his son's birth certificate, so he wants a DNA test!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Know About the Affair, But Is He the Father?
programme.desc: Stephanie gave birth to a baby boy and believes Brandon is the father. But Brandon claims he didn't find out about the child until three years later and denies being the father. Stephanie and her mother want Brandon to step up.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Gets The Real Update
programme.desc: Megan wanted to find out if her boyfriend Devin was cheating. But even darker relationship secrets surface! Plus, you'll be shocked to find out why Laura and Steven need Steve's help again!

programme.desc: Desmond believes that his ex Cassandra is making up a story about him touching their child because she's jealous of his new fiancée. And later, Tammy has been investigated for child abuse and even accused of locking her kids in a closet.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar en Rockkonsert / Valparna Räddar en örn

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar Francois på Djupt Vatten / Valparna Räddar Pingviner på Hal is

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar Jake / Valparna räddar paraden
programme.desc: När Jake och Chase utforskar en grotta råkar Jake fastna med sin fot mellan några stenar! // När Alex knyter fast för många ballonger på Katies paradvagn slutar det med att den flyger iväg!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar ett Spöke / Valparna Räddar en Pjäs

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar en Snowboardtävling / Valparna Räddar en Höna i Plurret

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar en Talangjakt / Valparna Räddar en Grillfest
programme.desc: Det är dags för Äventyrsbuktens stora talangjakt, men Borgmästare Rospigg upptäcker att det inte finns tillräckligt med tävlanden. // Ryder och valparna hjälper Bonden Al med förberedelserna inför den årliga grillfesten.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: Tyska befäl upptäcker effektiviteten i att gasa fångar, och Auschwitz förvandlas från ett litet bakvattenläger för de som motarbetar den nazistiska ockupationen av Polen, till ett storskaligt förintelseläger för judar.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: Höss hanterar komplikationer som uppstår från det provisoriska gaskammaren och den ökande efterfrågan då nazisterna börjar genomsöka hela Europa för fler människor att ta till Auschwitz och döda.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer SV
programme.desc: År 1945 fördes världen in i atomåldern. Med sin roll som bombens fader befäst blev Oppenheimer alltmer oroad över den potentiella fara som vetenskapliga uppfinningar kunde utgöra för mänskligheten.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Vince Neil, Laura Prepon, Connie Stevens, Haylie Duff
programme.desc: A small room in Laura Prepon's new home leaves her feeling very uneasy; a young Vince Neil hears mysterious noises coming from his bedroom closet.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Daryl Hannah, Maksim Chmerkovskiy, Shanna Moakler, Marilyn Manson
programme.desc: A young Daryl Hannah meets a mysterious woman who changes her life forever. Maksim Chmerkovskiy recovers from a devastating injury with the help of a woman who's not what she seems.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Rebecca De Mornay, Michael Rapaport, Margaret Cho
programme.desc: Faced with the possibility of death, Rebecca De Mornay is greeted by angelic spirits. A young Michael Rapaport and friends stumble upon ghosts in their high school basement.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Chris McDonald
programme.desc: Christopher McDonald and Kim Russo travel to Christopher's adolescent home in Romulus, NY where he had a ghostly encounter with the other side.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Linda Dano
programme.desc: Psychic Medium Kim Russo visits the home of Actress Linda Dano (Another World, One Life To Live) and finally discovers who has been haunting her 18th century house for the past two decades.

programme.title: Mitt super-ex
programme.desc: Matt (Luke Wilson) tror sigha funnit den rätta när han träffar Jenny (Uma Thurman) som är både sexig och smart... Men när Mattbestämmer sig för att göra slut, blir det något han snart kommer att ångra.

programme.title: Vampyrer suger
programme.desc: Sätt tänderna i den hysteriskt roliga parodinVAMPIRES SUCKs förlängda version BITE ME,med ännu mer sanslös humor och blodigt allvar.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Tito Ortiz
programme.desc: Tito Ortiz, (MMA Champion) returns to the Hollywood Hills home where a ghost drove him and his girlfriend Jenna Jameson away many years ago.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Don Most, Gena Lee Nolin, Fred Willard, Lolita Davidovich
programme.desc: Don Most takes on the apparition who haunts his girlfriend's home. Gena Lee Nolin is confronted by a murdered spirit when it appears during a violent exorcism.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: Nick and Tessa aim to connect with the spirit of William Morgan to uncover the truth behind his mysterious fate and validate the stories of his spectral presence within Frontier House.

programme.title: The Nanny: Tattoo
programme.desc: Maxwell is aroused after learning that Fran has a secret tattoo.

programme.title: The Nanny: Danny's Dead And Who's Got The Will?
programme.desc: Fran goes to her former fiance Danny's funeral, and fearing she may end up alone, she pushes Maxwell for a commitment.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Bank Robbery
programme.desc: Fran and Sylvia are taken hostage in a Valentine's Day bank robbery.

programme.title: The Nanny: From Flushing With Love
programme.desc: Fran uses a trip to Niagara Falls to inspire Maxwell to propose.

programme.title: The Nanny: One False Mole And You're Dead
programme.desc: Fran accidentally discovers the secret behind a movie star's famous beauty mark.

programme.title: The Nanny: Not Without My Nanny
programme.desc: Fran and Grace visit a Middle Eastern prince and his family.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Wedding Pt. 1
programme.desc: Superstition threatens to derail Fran and Maxwell's wedding.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Wedding Pt. 2
programme.desc: Superstition threatens to derail Fran and Maxwell's wedding.

programme.title: The Nanny: Mom's The Word

programme.title: The Nanny: Finale, Part 1

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1990s, one criminal terrorized an entire community. Witnesses refused to speak out. They knew the consequences could be deadly.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: A small convoy heads out with an oversized load; Lisa Kelly and Reno Ward's skills are tested by the treacherous journey; Art Burke attempts to navigate an ice road over a frozen lake; Alex Debogorski stops to help a stranded trucker.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Reno Ward has a disastrous encounter with a speeding pick-up truck; Lisa Kelly attempts to rescue Reno but is forced to leave him to fend for himself; Art Burke attempts to deliver a Zamboni to save an isolated community's hockey season.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: A big bump takes out Art Burke's radiator; Todd Dewey's rig lands in a snowbank; Steph Custance regrets her foray onto a wet ice crossing; Alex Debogorski uses a sled to drag a construction shack across a frozen lake.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Bowling Pin Payday
programme.desc: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: När en gruva kollapsar i Kanada fångas en grupp gruvarbetare. Nu måste Jim hitta långtradarförare som kan transportera räddningsutrustning via farliga isvägar över frusna vatten innan det är för sent.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Efter terrorattackerna den 11 september utser kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg till att leda kompensationsfonden för offren. Feinberg står nu inför en omöjlig uppgift - att avgöra vad ett liv är värt.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: 1968 anländer Judy Garland till London för en rad utsålda konserter. Utåt charmar Judy alla med sin värme och karisma, men inuti är hon djupt ärrad av ett liv i rampljuset och en tuff vårdnadstvist.

programme.title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
programme.desc: Två rivaliserande fastighetsmäklare tvingas samarbeta för att sälja ett speciellt hus, ägt av en känd botaniker och mistelodlare, före jul.

programme.title: Married by Christmas
programme.desc: Carrie ägnar dag och natt åt fars verksamhet och har inte mycket tid för ett socialt liv. Men plötsligt får hon reda på att hon måste gifta sig innan jul för att få ärva verksamheten av sin farmor.

programme.title: Oh Christmas Tree!
programme.desc: När en kvinna oväntat förlorar sitt jobb måste hon arbeta på familjens julgransförsäljning för att klara sig under julhelgen.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Audrey Reyes
programme.desc: Audrey is the quintessential Miami girl, she loves the sun, the beach and, most of all, herself! And soon, this self-proclaimed princess will have the most extravagant and exciting My Super Sweet 16 bash that Miami has ever seen.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Malia Murray
programme.desc: All the world is a stage for Malia, and the stylish Atlanta native has it all: looks, brains and, most importantly, money. She's throwing a huge My Super Sweet 16 bash and wants to prove that the world revolves around her.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: DJ Tillman
programme.desc: Money and fame are no strangers to DJ, stepson of the Houston Texans' Danny Clark. This spoiled ladies' man gets everything he wants and organises his own My Super Sweet 16 party.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Alexandria Andrews
programme.desc: Alexandria is your typical My Super Sweet 16er, she's confident, fashionable and rich! Allie, as she likes to be called, knows exactly what she wants, and it's either her way or the highway.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Savannah
programme.desc: To be a true California girl, you need blonde hair, blue eyes and a great tan and Savannah has got it all. But good looks are not the only weapon she has in her arsenal; she's also got lots of dough.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Finale Stephanie
programme.desc: Stefanie is the Next Super Sweet 16er winner and she's going to throw the hardest rockin' party ever. Helped out by party planners for the stars, celebrity designers and some Sweet 16 all stars, Stefanie's party is sure to be amazing.

programme.desc: Geri is not your regular average teenager and that's an understatement. She has a Rocky Horror Picture Show-themed party complete with drag queens, little people and mannequins galore!

programme.desc: Chanae is a preacher's daughter who is blessed with everything she wants. When her Mom tells her that the budget for her Rock Star bash has been reached, Chanae declares that Jesus wouldn't want her to have a budget.

programme.desc: You may know superstar Sean Kingston by his mega hit Beautiful Girls, but you're about to see a whole new side of the platinum selling rapper when he welcomes you to his home island of Jamaica for his 18th birthday blowout!

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Bow Wow
programme.desc: Now that he's turning 21, Bow Wow is ready to show the world that he's no longer 'lil', and wants to prove world that he's all grown up. He's throwing a birthday party in D.C. for his fans, and an over-the-top celebrity soiree on the Vegas strip.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16: Taylor

programme.desc: Tyra surprises the girls in a dance studio and teaches them how to work their fierceness while posing at the end of a runway.

programme.desc: The models are spilt into two teams for go-sees with Shoshanna Lonstein, Pamella Roland and Stacey Bendit from Alice & Olivia.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 1
programme.desc: Det är nervöst och spänt när 600 Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders-aspiranter anländer till hotellet för uttagningarna. Varje tävlande har två minuter att dansa för domarna.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2
programme.desc: I slututtagningen blir det kraftig konkurrens och endast de starka överlever. DCC-aspiranter måste nu tävla mot cheerleaderveteraner för att få en plats på träningslägret.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3
programme.desc: Om kandidaterna trodde att uttagningarna var tuffa så har de ingen aning om hur brutalt träningslägret kommer att vara. Första veckan på Valley Ranch inleds med att tjejerna får veta vad för poäng de fick av domarna.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4
programme.desc: Det är bara tredje veckan på träningslägret, men det är redan dags att börja skicka hem folk. Vem kommer att överleva? Veckan börjar med uniformsprovning där även aspiranterna får prova den berömda blå och vita, stjärnbeströdda uniformen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5
programme.desc: Dags att ta fram tjejernas DCC-look. Rakt eller lockigt hår? Blond eller rödhårig? Tjejerna vet ingenting om vad Kelli och frisören Rainer Schneck har planerat för dem när de får sin dramatiska DCC-makeover.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: När DCC-chefen Kelli Finglass ger en före detta aspirant en unik chans att hoppa in i träningslägret efter tre veckor har hon mycket att ta igen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: Hon är tillbaka! Den krävande Kitty Carter kommer till Valley Ranch för att lära ut dansteknik till de skraja DCC-dansarna. Sen tar Charlotte Jones Anderson de förundrade hejaklacksledarna på en privat rundtur i nya Cowboys Stadium.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: Kelli och Judy är tvungna att fatta svåra val som är rättvisa, men ändå beklagansvärda. Det här är sista chansen för träningslägerkandidaterna - det är bara två danslektioner kvar innan de sista skickas hem.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 4
programme.desc: In the final episode of the series, the team of Barnsley Casualty pull together to treat a new raft of emergency patients. They work like a family to face the best and worst of life together.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 1
programme.desc: It’s Monday at Barnsley Casualty, traditionally the busiest day of the week and they’re expecting to treat 277 patients. But it soon becomes clear that this shift could break the hospital record of 349 patients, a number that no-one wants to beat.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 2
programme.desc: Freezing fog has descended across the whole of South Yorkshire so Barnsley Casualty is inundated with weather-related accidents and emergencies.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 3
programme.desc: After eight weeks off with a fractured hip, Consultant Dr Julian Humphrey returns to work at Barnsley Casualty. A keen cyclist, he came off his bike in Sheffield and by his own admission is ‘a bit accident prone – I’m the NHS secret shopper.’

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 4
programme.desc: It’s a busy day in Barnsley Hospital’s casualty department and one that holds a special significance for Nurse Jade Melia - it’s her last shift.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 5
programme.desc: Sister Jane Hawksworth is managing the ambulance arrivals, ‘It’s so unpredictable and you can have the worst day ever and think nothing can compare to it and then come back and have another worst day ever. And then gradually the days will get better.’

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 5
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Scout Leader and Single mum of two; Debbie from South London, whose 2-bed flat is drowning in clutter and filth.

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 6
programme.desc: In South Wales, 49-year-old Alison has always been a hoarder. What started as a passion for teddy bears has transformed into an obsession for. She currently has 11 and they rule the house, at least the bits they can get to in between the hoard…

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 8
programme.desc: 79-year-old Joyce moved into her dream home in Liverpool nearly 40 years ago with her partner, Norman. But when he passed away, she lost her battle to keep on top of the hoarding behavior she inherited from her mum.

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 9
programme.desc: What happens when a hoarder can no longer live safely in their home and the family are left to pick up the pieces? House clearance experts Ange and Yvonne have been called in by the daughters of a lifelong hoarder to clear their dad’s house.

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode we meet 63-year-old Jane, a retired nurse from Southeast London. Jane’s inability to start a family brought on her hoarding tendencies and 27 years later, her 2 bedroomed terrace home is full to the rafters with furniture and books.

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 14

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 15

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 16
programme.desc: Recovery op Jim Howard is dispatched to a serious incident. A van has collided with an artic forcing the vehicles behind to brake suddenly resulting in a major pile up. Recovery op Marta is struggling to collect an artic from a lorry graveyard.

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 17
programme.desc: Recovery Ops Marta and Pat have to pull a bin lorry out of a muddy ditch - luckily, they have a specialized off-road vehicle that is just the tool for the job. Recovery drivers Roman and Nick have to deliver an antique tank worth 20 grand to a buyer.

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 18

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2505
programme.desc: Raj gör några stora fynd i en liten butik och beger sig till en berömd taverna för att lära sig mer om guizing. Irita hittar en målning som påminner henne om hennes barndom.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2506

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2507

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2508
programme.desc: Charles orsakar kaos i antikvitetsbutikerna innan han upptäcker ursprunget till Yorkshire Pudding. Tasha besöker Leeds för att lära sig mer om en banbrytande filmskapare.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Takeover
programme.desc: A political boss hires a professional provocateur to stage a violent protest, in a maneuver to discredit his state's governor and elevate his puppet, the mayor, to the governorship in "Takeover"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Missile
programme.desc: The IMF devises an elaborate scheme to dupe foreign agent James Reed into stealing a bogus missile guidance system in "The Missile"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Blast
programme.desc: Henry Darrow guest stars as Gregory Tolan, the local leader of a revolutionist group specializing in robberies for the financing of a movement to overthrow the United States government in the "Blast"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: Andrew Duggan guest stars as Justin Bainbridge, a multimillionaire paranoid militarist, whose son, Howard, defected behind the Iron Curtain with the formula to a lethal nerve gas he had developed in "A Ghost Story"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Party
programme.desc: The whereabouts of a list of enemy agents operating in the United States are locked in the memory of a captured spy, Col. Vanin (guest star Frank Marth), and no one, including the spy, can penetrate his mind in "The Party"

programme.title: MacGyver: The Negotiator
programme.desc: MacGyver is marked for death after stopping the construction of a proposed marina and unknowingly falls in love with the hired killer sent to stop him.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Spoilers (Aka "Earthquake")
programme.desc: MacGyver comes to the rescue of a mountain man who has been framed for murder after agreeing to testify against a chemical company that is illegally disposing of hazardous materials in nearby streams.

programme.title: MacGyver: Mask of the Wolf
programme.desc: MacGyver and Jack Dalton come to the rescue of an Indian who is kidnapped by fortune hunters seeking the secret location of a legendary mask.

programme.title: MacGyver: Rock and Cradle
programme.desc: An abandoned baby lands MacGyver and Jack Dalton in the middle of a sophisticated counterfeiting scheme.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Endangered
programme.desc: After visiting an old flame who's now working as a Park Ranger, MacGyver finds himself in the middle of a grizzly poaching investigation.

programme.title: MacGyver: Murderer's Sky
programme.desc: MacGyver protects a 14-year-old from the mob after his grandfather is killed for refusing to sell out his international shipping company.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 701
programme.desc: Cecilie och Kristoffer bor med sin lille son i en sliten lägenhet i Århus, men drömmer om plats och lugn och ro. Men hur lugn blir man när man plötsligt äger ett hus som man inte känner sig hemma i?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 702
programme.desc: Bianca och Morten bor i Randers med tung trafik utanför hemmet, och två små flickor som har lärt sig att öppna ytterdörren. Det fungerar inte, så de ber experterna om hjälp.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 703
programme.desc: I Esbjerg har Line och Kristian byggt sitt drömhus, eller det är vad de trodde. Öppna ytor och stora fönster faller dem inte längre i smaken, men vad ska de istället ha?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 704
programme.desc: För några år sedan sålde Birgitte sitt hus, och ångrade det bittert. Nu hyr hon och dottern Emma ett dyrt nybygge medan de letar efter ett hus som liknar det gamla. Kan experterna hjälpa dem?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö & Copenhagen
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new nordic cuisine. He visits a local goat farmer and meets up with young enthusiastic chefs who takes this nordic legacy further.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Zealand
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor visits the South Coast of Denmark to make his own versions of open-faced sandwiches and smoked fish dishes.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: First Date
programme.desc: Anna är rasande efter att ha sett några pinsamma klipp. Två tidigare medverkande kastas in, och Marty förstör stämningen. Gary gör allt för Charlotte när de dejtar.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: Holly's Dream Comes True
programme.desc: Hollys dröm blir verklighet när en person från förr dyker upp, men hur kommer resten av familjen att reagera? Charlottes team lovar to sabotera för Garys som hämnd, men lyckas de eller går planen i baklås?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: Charlotte Messes Up
programme.desc: Scotty T är tillbaka och det tisslas och tasslas i huset. En S&M-kväll på jobbet får Charlottes team att känna sig uppeggade. Ett stort misstag begås, som tvingar Gary att lämna huset. Är allt över för honom och Charlotte?!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: And The Winner Is...
programme.desc: Det är säsongsfinal, men utan Gaz och med en upprörd Charlotte måste båda lagen hitta nya ledare. Anna har en överraskning, men vilka är det som har vunnit tävlingen? Kommer Charlotte och Gaz att klara sig? Det blir ett tårdrypande farväl.

programme.title: Geordie Shore Cast Reacts: 201
programme.desc: Gänget från "Geordie Shore" får sällskap av förra deltagarna Charlotte, Holly och James, och tar en titt på de senaste avsnitten för att återuppleva vad som hände de suddiga nätterna.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Song of Orpheus

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Dark Spirit

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: A Children's Story

programme.title: JAG: Need to Know

programme.title: Forensic Files: Second Shot at Love
programme.desc: When heart surgeon Darryl Sutorius is found dead in the basement of his upscale Cincinnati home, police assume he committed suicide. Further investigation reveals that his new wife Della has a history of violence and an insatiable desire for money.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: 6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker was killed in a hit-and-run in her Ft. Lauderdale neighborhood. The prosecutor combines the talents of an accident reconstruction expert with a video specialist to create a graphic demonstration of the moment of impact.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Video Diary
programme.desc: When convenience store employee Wanda Mason is found dead, investigators find the entire murder has been caught on the store's security camera. But the image of the killer is so degraded it seems impossible to positively identify him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Knowledge
programme.desc: Police investigate a missing college girl and discover her double life: attending school by day and working as a call-girl by night. Her body is found and investigators find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing in Time
programme.desc: A woman is reported missing after a fight with her husband. Police suspect a man who reported a fire in his car. Two tiny drops of blood are found in the interior. Finally, a tiny clue inside the suspect's watchband helps solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing Pearl
programme.desc: In 1991, Maine resident Pearl Smith goes missing after an argument with her husband, Bill Bruns. When investigators find a blood trail that leads to the couple's basement, police are sure they'll find the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Man's Best Friend?
programme.desc: In 1989, 4-year-old April Loveless was found dead in the backyard of her Texas home. Her parents told police that she was attacked and killed by wild dogs. Investigators did not agree.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hand Delivered
programme.desc: In 1995, San Diego police are baffled by a pair of hands found in a dumpster. Through further investigation, they determine that the hands are those of missing person Don Hardin.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fire Dot Com
programme.desc: In 1996, a federal agency ruled that Terri Strickland had intentionally set the fire that killed her 17-month-old son, Josh Hinson. Using the then-emerging resources of the internet, Strickland undertook her own investigation.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Mistaken For Dead
programme.desc: In 1988, when a patient dies unexpectedly in the office of California neurologist Richard Boggs, police begin what they think will be a routine investigation. Soon they uncover a bizarre story of corpse stealing, fake identity and sexual perversion.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Evidence
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before the evidence melts away. The shoe leads investigators to Peter Benedict and Frank Lanoue, who are convicted of aggravated assault and robbery.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: COPS: First Time Caller
programme.desc: A fleet-footed deputy nabs a suspect on the run, officers responding to a domestic call are refused entry, and police try to ascertain the cause of a woman's hallucinations.

programme.title: COPS: Kicking and Screaming
programme.desc: An intoxicated man suspected of domestic abuse refuses to obey deputies' orders, police find drugs in a woman's car, and an alleged prostitute encounters the police.

programme.title: COPS: Mixed Emotions
programme.desc: A traffic stop escalates to a dangerous situation, a woman admits to hitting her dad in the face with her teeth, and a defiant driver doesn't want deputies to search his car.

programme.title: COPS: Better Safe Than Sorry
programme.desc: Officers try to calm an agitated and disoriented man before he hurts himself or someone else, and a driver going 2 MPH on a highway catches the attention of a patrol car.

programme.title: COPS: Funny Money
programme.desc: Cops pursue a man skipping bail, an impaired driver is surprisingly cooperative, and officers struggle to remove a violent offender from a crime scene.

programme.title: COPS: Pants Down, Hit the Ground
programme.desc: A man learns a hard lesson about wearing his seatbelt, and police perform a traffic stop and uncover a sad man with a strange story.

programme.title: COPS: British Invasion
programme.desc: A desperate trespasser attempts to give the cops the slip, and a frightened man tries to get the attention of deputies but takes the wrong approach.

programme.title: COPS: One, Two, Tree
programme.desc: A high-speed pursuit ends abruptly when the suspect makes a wrong turn, and a nervous man attempts to hide his crime when he thinks no one can see him.

programme.title: COPS: Wake Up Call
programme.desc: A lawbreaker tries to convince the cops that he's a good guy, and deputies smell trouble during a traffic stop.

programme.title: COPS: Just Hanging Out
programme.desc: A jumpy bicyclist mistakenly reveals more than he had planned, and officers search a darkened building in an attempt to thwart a robbery in progress.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Laurence Dromard Case
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want her dead.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.desc: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: Tidigt en februarimorgon i Stockholm anmäler en man sin fru, Sacha, försvunnen. När polisen gräver i parets förflutna upptäcker de under den till synes ordnade ytan en turbulent relation.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 302
programme.desc: En 21-årig teaterstudent kliver ur en bil i södra Tyskland och hävdar för tysk polis att han kidnappats och sedan tvingats mörda sin vän och hyresvärd. Men är hans version av historien verkligen sann? (Del 1)

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 1103
programme.desc: I augusti 2019 hittas en man svårt blödande efter att ha knivskurits. Polisen kan inte knyta misstänkta till dådet, eller hitta ledtrådar i och med det brott offret själv utretts för.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 702
programme.desc: Paret Suzanne och Lars lever ett stillsamt liv ute på landet utanför Stockholm. Men när Suzanne på kort varsel avbokar en viktig tennismatch, blir hennes tennispartner misstänksam och larmar polisen.

programme.title: I huvudet på en gärningsman: Avsnitt 206
programme.desc: Utåt sett hade den 30-årige bedragaren allt. Han var stilig, charmig och framgångsrik. Men allt var bara en bluff. Istället utnyttjar han människor för att komma åt deras pengar för att kunna leva i lyx.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 105
programme.desc: Göran Lundblad mördades av sin egen dotter Sara och hennes pojkvän i Förlösa 2012, ett mord som gick rätt in i hjärtat på många svenskar. Motivet tros ha varit ett arv på många miljoner.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar Borgmästarens Lopp / Valparna Räddar ett Rövarbyte

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna och Köldknäppen / Valparna Räddar en Basketmatch
programme.desc: En snöstorm drar in över Äventyrsbukten och förvandlar hela staden till en glashal isbana. // Borgmästare Rospigg utmanar Borgmästare Överdängares basketlag på en match. Det finns bara ett problem - Borgmästare Rospigg har inget basketlag!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar ett Bröllop / Valparna Räddar Ace
programme.desc: Bonden Al och Bonden Yumi ska gifta sig, och valparna har fullt upp med att förbereda inför bröllopet. // Skyes favoritstuntpilot, Ace Sörensen, besöker Äventyrsbukten med sin nya fantastiska luftshow, men på vägen dit får planet problem med motorn!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpar på äventyr med Dinosaurier
programme.desc: Valparna besöker en arkeologisk utgrävning där de hittar tre dinosaurieägg. Plötsligt kläcks äggen, och tre flygödlor flyger ut! Nu är det upp till Paw Patrol att försöka fånga de förrymda dinosaurierna!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Den Nya Valpen
programme.desc: Paw Patrol rycker ut med sin nya Paw Patroller för att rädda Jake som är strandsatt ute på isen. Valparna får oväntad hjälp från den modiga lilla Everest!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar ett äventyr / Valparna Räddar en överraskning
programme.desc: Marshall och resten av valparna lär Alex allt om eldsäkerhet // Det verkade först som en helt vanlig dag för valparna, men det dröjer inte länge förrän de får en stor överraskning! Det är nämligen 'Uppskatta Paw Patrol'-dagen!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar Valinda / Valparna Räddar ett Stort ben
programme.desc: Valparna planerar en stor fest för Valle Valross. Men när han inte dyker upp, så upptäcker de att han träffat en ny vän vid namn Valinda! // Vid en utgrävning hittar kapten Piggvar plötsligt ett stort dinosaurieben!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar en Snuva / Valparna och Spökstugan
programme.desc: Medan Rubble och Ryder letar efter Als bortsprungna grisar, stannar Marshall hemma för att ta hand om de andra förkylda valparna. // Först försvinner Rubbles lunch, och sedan är plötsligt Jakes lunchlåda borta! Kan det vara ett spöke?

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar Dykarklockan / Valparna Räddar Bävrarna
programme.desc: Kapten Piggvar och hans kusin dyker ner i havet för att ta kort på en ovanlig sjösnigel, men dykarklockan fastnar nere i djupet. // Ett oväder har spolat bort bävern Gnagis damm. För att bygga en ny, gnager han av allt trä på Bonden Yumis gård.

programme.title: iCarly: Replikmisstag
programme.desc: Skådespelarna bjuder på felsägningar och bortklippta scener från serien.

programme.title: iCarly: Mitt heta rum
programme.desc: Spencer försöker överraska Carly på födelsedagen, men det slutar med att han bränner ned hennes sovrum i stället. Men när försäkringsbolaget ger honom en stor check, får han chansen att gottgöra henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Bröllopsbesvär
programme.desc: Efter att ett iCarly-fan har friat till sin flickvän live under webb-showen, känner gänget att de måste vara med på bröllopet. Men när bruden får kalla fötter måste Carly komma till undsättning.

programme.title: iCarly: Tröjor till salu
programme.desc: Gänget ger sig in i businessvärlden genom att tillverka och sälja t-shirts. Efter att försäljningen skjutit i höjden, rekryterar Sam fjärdeklassare för att göra tröjor. Men Carly, Sam & Freddie är inte överens om hur de ska behandla dem.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag är på bushumör
programme.desc: När hon blir hånad för att hon aldrig har hittat på något busigt skämt, rekryterar Carly Spencer för att skoja med Sam och Freddie. Men när Spencer får smak på det, kan han inte sluta skämta. Gänget måste komma på ett sätt att få stopp på honom.

programme.title: iCarly: Sams mamma
programme.desc: Efter att ha bråkat med sin mamma flyttar Sam in till Carly, som snart inser att hon är en fasansfull gäst. Freddie blir förföljd av en farlig brottsling efter att ha fångat honom på film när han begick ett brott.

programme.title: iCarly: iPity the Nevel
programme.desc: När en video där Nevel skriker åt en liten flicka börjar spridas på nätet, blir Nevel hatad av alla. Efter att ha firat Nevels fall hjälper iCarlygänget Nevel att återfå sin ära, eftersom han har bett dem om hjälp.

programme.title: iCarly: iHire an Idiot
programme.desc: Carly och Sam anställer en snygg kille för att hjälpa till i showen.

programme.title: iCarly: OMG
programme.desc: Gänget spenderar natten på Ridgeway med att göra klart sina skolprojekt under skolans årliga inlåsningstradition. Carly och Freddie börjar misstänka att Sam kanske är kär i deras nya kompis Brad.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious
programme.desc: Carly misstänker att hennes nya pojkvän, Steven, är otrogen mot henne med Tori Vega, så gänget planerar en tripp till Los Angeles för att ta honom på bar gärning på Andres party hemma i Kenan Thompsons hus.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
programme.desc: A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mirror

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Where is Everybody?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Denton on Doomsday

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Efterlyst tar upp den våg av inbrott på skolor som har ägt rum sedan i våras, där värdet på stölderna är över en miljon kronor. Vi visar också rånet mot Guldfynds butik på Södermalm den 7 juli.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Efterlyst är i Jönköping där 43-årige Simon hittades mördad i ett skogsområde i januari 2024. Vi får se övervakningsbilder på medlemmar i ligan som misstänks för minst 21 stölder från byggbutiker.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Vi får se en övervakningsfilm på den brutala attack som drabbade en man i 40-årsåldern i Uppsala den 17 augusti. Efterlyst tar upp inbrotten i jaktbutiker som ägt rum i Grums respektive Nyköping.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Efterlyst är i Umeå och hjälper polisen att klara ut ett fall med det sadistiska nätverket 764. Här hetsas unga personer att utföra grova brott, begå självmord och skada sig själva inför kameror.

programme.title: Mannen som talar med hundar: Delta and Dong Dong
programme.desc: Delta, a dog with aggressive behavior and a fear of men. Dong-Dong, a rescue from Taiwan, who has found solace in the living room chair of his adopted home. He won’t get up for anything.

programme.title: Mannen som talar med hundar: Tyson, Moose, and Rylie & Tucker
programme.desc: Model Kim Strother is in desperate need of rescuing. Her Yorkshire Terrier Moose is a menace to society. when they go for walks, barking and biting at passersby and their dogs.

programme.title: Mannen som talar med hundar: Roxie & Foxy, Charlie, and Bubba & Lucky

programme.desc: Two pit bulls adopted together, turn on each other. Cesar is called in to bring these dueling pit bulls back together and stop their raging dog aggression.

programme.title: Mannen som talar med hundar: UK Special 1

programme.title: South Park: Döda kändisar

programme.title: South Park: Zimmermans världskrig
programme.desc: Cartman anser Token vara ett hot mot hela mänskligheten.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand

programme.title: Paradise Hotel

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Svartsjuka och ilska över ”fuckad vibe” frodas på hotellet. Det är dags för prov i hemkunskap med en åtråvärd immunitet i potten för den elev som får bäst resultat.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Är det bäst att ”gå sin egen väg” eller är det bättre att ”lyssna på gruppen”? Ännu en tjej kommer tvingas checka ut från Paradise Hotel när det har blivit dags för parceremoni!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 5
programme.desc: Ny skoldag och klassens lärare bestämmer att dagens utmaning för eleverna är att förbereda roliga timmen för varandra.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 7

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 8
programme.desc: Stämningen är ordentligt sänkt på hotellet efter Pandoras Slakt – och blir inte bättre när ännu en hotellgäst tvingas checka ut efter en dramatisk dolkceremoni.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 8
programme.desc: Dags för FINAL i Paradise Hotel! De fyra som kämpat sig kvar till slutet börjar dagen med att bli serverade frukost på sängen av Rebecca Stella. Därefter ska fyra bli två i finalceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 5
programme.desc: I sann flower power-anda bjuds deltagarna på nyckelparty. Kärleken är fri och nya par ska bildas.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 5
programme.desc: De gamla asagudarna vakar över hotellet när morgonen gryr. Det är midvinterblot, och någon måste offras till gudarna.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 7
programme.desc: Sanel och Lisa utsågs till hotellets bästa par – men det visar snart att det inte gav dem någon fördel. Istället tvingas de ta ett tufft beslut: utse en av killarna som ska tvingas checka ut omedelbart.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer SV
programme.desc: År 1945 fördes världen in i atomåldern. Med sin roll som bombens fader befäst blev Oppenheimer alltmer oroad över den potentiella fara som vetenskapliga uppfinningar kunde utgöra för mänskligheten.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: They are iconic weapons: the Tommy Gun, Uzi, and today’s MP5. Invented to break WWI stalemates, the submachine gun revolutionized warfare and culture. Host Wil Willis explores its evolution, firing the Thompson and BAR.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Artillery, "The King of Battle," has shaped history from ancient cannons to today's M777 Howitzer. Host Wil Willis visits Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to witness modern artillery like the M777 and M109 Paladin in action.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Secret War: Double Agent Tricycle
programme.desc: Dusan Popov was almost certainly James Bond. Ian Fleming knew all the stories about him. Popov managed to persuade both the Germans and MI6 to keep him in the style of a millionaire businessman while performing a series of missions against the Nazis.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Linda Dano
programme.desc: Psychic Medium Kim Russo visits the home of Actress Linda Dano (Another World, One Life To Live) and finally discovers who has been haunting her 18th century house for the past two decades.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Tom Green
programme.desc: Comedian Tom Green returns to his hometown in Ottawa, Canada to confront a ghost.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Jesse Metcalf
programme.desc: Actor Jesse Metcalf (Dallas, Desperate Housewives) returns to his childhood home in Connecticut where he and his family had paranormal experiences more than two decades ago.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 4
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Anita from Manchester, who’s house is overrun with her 3 cats who make a mess wherever they like.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 5
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Scout Leader and Single mum of two; Debbie from South London, whose 2-bed flat is drowning in clutter and filth.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 6
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of American born dog loving Dani from Shepton Mallet who moved to the UK with high hopes of living the English Country dream, but bad health got the better of her.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: Nick and Tessa aim to connect with the spirit of William Morgan to uncover the truth behind his mysterious fate and validate the stories of his spectral presence within Frontier House.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Fire in the Church
programme.desc: Nick tries to determine if the ghosts of priests that died in a 1948 fire are haunting the property today.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Warwick Prison
programme.desc: Nick tries to contact the ghost of a serial killer who haunts buildings in the Warwick Prison complex.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Chazz Palminteri
programme.desc: Kim and Chazz find out why the ghost contacted him and other messages he has to deliver.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Billy Dee Williams, Jenna Morasca, Dee Wallace, Kathrine Narducci
programme.desc: Billy Dee Williams escapes from a home in Los Angeles after he has a terrifying encounter with the spirit of a woman who was tragically killed in the home.

programme.title: The Nanny: Finale, Part 1
programme.desc: As she worries about getting too fat, Fran goes into labor while stuck in an elevator with C.C.

programme.title: The Nanny: Finale, Part 2
programme.desc: Fran delivers her twins as C.C. gives Niles an answer to his marriage proposal.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Nanny
programme.desc: A door-to-door cosmetics saleswoman falls into a job as a wealthy family's nanny.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Butler, The Husband, The Wife And Her Mother
programme.desc: Fran persuades the family to help her dupe a nosy cousin.

programme.title: The Nanny: Sunday In The Park With Fran
programme.desc: Grace and the son of a prominent theater critic Frank Bradley get in a fight during a trip to the park, and, to break it up, Fran bops the boy with a baguette -- which could mean curtains for Maxwell's newest Broadway play.

programme.title: The Nanny: A Star Is Unborn
programme.desc: Fran is cast in a Broadway production of "Romeo and Juliet."

programme.title: The Nanny: When You Pish Upon A Star
programme.desc: Fran regrets encouraging Maxwell to hire a young TV star for his next play.

programme.title: The Nanny: A Fine Friendship
programme.desc: Fran confides in an attractive male that she thinks is gay.

programme.title: The Nanny: A Kiss Is Just A Kiss
programme.desc: Fran and Maggie enter a kissing contest with country music superstar Billy Ray Cyrus.

programme.title: The Nanny: Strange Bed Fellows
programme.desc: A fellow nanny's retirement causes Fran to worry about her own future.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2510
